title: Manage learner groups and bulk enrollment
intro: Mobbin evidence for course rosters and bulk enrollment analogues.

questions.title: Roster view: status, role, group origin, exceptions visible
Bulk paths (CSV, code/link, integration) alongside manual add

references.title: Community roster and member management screen
references.question: Q3
references.take: Circle’s Members table shows role, joined date, paywall and last activity with add/export controls. It does not show group origin or individual enrollment exceptions.

references.title: Student roster view
references.question: Q3
references.take: The Students table filters by Enrolled In Specific Course(s) and exposes bulk actions, email opt-out and account/activity metadata. It is course-filtered; group origin and exceptions are not shown.

references.title: Class member list
references.question: Q3
references.take: An education-adjacent class screen makes the learner list itself the primary management object.

references.title: Team member management screen
references.question: Q3
references.take: A team-management analogue supports scanning membership records as a dedicated administrative view.

references.title: Exporting students
references.question: Q4
references.take: Circle’s three-step flow explicitly covers exporting students, showing a structured bulk-data path adjacent to roster management.

references.title: Adding students
references.question: Q4
references.take: Students → Add Students → manually enter learners → choose a course/product and payment/access basis → Import → success feedback. Import CSV is a sibling tab, but its mapping and execution are not captured.

references.title: Team membership flow
references.question: Q4
references.take: Fireflies’ team flow is a relevant analogue for managing a group of people through a dedicated team entry point.

references.title: Course dashboard with member context
references.question: Q3
references.take: The course dashboard shows student progress, last activity and start date; later previews visit comments. Course status Open is not a learner enrollment status. Roles, group origin and exceptions are not shown.

references.title: Course learner management surface
references.question: Q4
references.take: Teachable is a direct education analogue surfaced for selecting or managing course learners from the course side.

references.title: Space member access screen
references.question: Q4
references.take: During course-space creation, select a Space group and optionally Add members from this space group. Existing-group inheritance is visible; later membership propagation is not established.
